subject: POC launch: critical-path checklist for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Emma Brennan <emma.brennan@catalysthealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: itops@catalysthealth.com, procurement@catalysthealth.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC launch: initial ask on network and keys

Thanks Aditya — excited to get the POC moving. Quick questions after the demo:

- For API keys: will we receive per-environment keys (staging/prod) or a single key for the trial?
- Org setup: what minimal IAM role should our SRE assign so we can onboard without over-permissioning?
- IP allowlist: we will manage a short list in our firewall; do you have a stable egress IP list for the Dedicated trial, or do you require VPC peering first?

Can we lock these items by EOD Tuesday so the compliance review can start?

Thanks,
Emma Brennan
Head of Engineering, Catalyst Health
emma.brennan@catalysthealth.com
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Emma Brennan <emma.brennan@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC launch: initial ask on network and keys

Emma — great questions. Below is the critical-path breakdown; I also attached a one-page MAP (MAP-CatalystHealth-v1.xlsx) that maps owners and target dates. Short answers first, details after.

1) API keys: we will provision one short-lived staging key for the POC and a separate long-lived key if you move to Dedicated. Staging key TTL: 30 days (renewable).
2) Org setup: create an org record in our console and invite a single admin (SRE). Role: "Org Admin (onramp)" which grants org-level visibility and API key minting only. No infra-wide elevated permissions required.
3) IP allowlist vs VPC peering: for quick onramp we can use IP allowlist. If you require private connectivity for PHI demo, VPC peering is the expected path — that adds ~5 business days for networking and routing validation.

Action items (proposed timeline):
- Tue 23 Mar: Catalyst to provide SRE email for Org Admin invite + desired staging subdomain.
- Wed 24 Mar: Redwood to send staging API key + network egress IPs for allowlist
- Thu 25 Mar: Catalyst to confirm allowlist applied; Redwood run smoke test
- Mon 29 Mar: Optional VPC peering kickoff (if requested)

I looped in Grace (CS lead) and Marissa (eng ops) to handle credentials and the peering checklist. If that timeline looks good, I'll upload a DocuSign for the POC MSA (small redline for trial).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: MAP-CatalystHealth-v1.xlsx (owners & dates)
From: Emma Brennan <emma.brennan@catalysthealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: itops@catalysthealth.com, procurement@catalysthealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC launch: critical-path checklist for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Thanks — that timeline is tight but doable. Confirming: SRE contact is dmitri.kozlov@catalysthealth.com. Our security team prefers peering for any PHI-related tests, but we can begin with allowlist for the first two demo runs.

A couple of asks on our side:
- Can you supply a limited set of token-scoped examples for logs/retention policy so our compliance team can pre-approve?
- We will need a network diagram to drop into the ticket (basic subnet/peering flow).

If you can push the staging key Wednesday morning, we will apply allowlist and confirm by Thursday end of day.

Emma
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Emma Brennan <emma.brennan@catalysthealth.com>, dmitri.kozlov@catalysthealth.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC launch: critical-path checklist for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Emma / Dmitri — looping in the operational artifacts you requested.

- Logs/Retention: For the POC we retain request/response metadata for 14 days by default; no full payload persistence unless customer opts in. We will provide a short PDF with the exact fields that appear in logs (timestamp, request id, model, prompt length, token count, error codes).
- Network diagram: attached (poc-network-diagram.png). It shows the allowlist flow and optional VPC peering path with route tables and NAT egress endpoints.

Next steps I will take: provision staging org record and invite dmitri as Org Admin; generate the staging API key and flag it as trial/staging; publish the IP egress list that you can paste into the firewall. Expect the invite + key by 2027-03-24T14:00Z.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachment: poc-network-diagram.png

All good on our side — we applied the allowlist and verified connectivity to the staging endpoint. Smoke tests returned nominal responses. A couple of notes from infra team:

- Please issue the staging API key to dmitri.kozlov@catalysthealth.com and mark TTL to 30 days.
- We will open a ticket for VPC peering; target kickoff 2027-03-29 if the MSA is signed.

If you can drop the DocuSign for the POC MSA, procurement will sign and we can move the peering request into the queue.

Thanks,
Dmitri Kozlov
SRE, Catalyst Health
